long_biography.plain_text:
Recovery redirected Eric Spofford’s life. With financial backing from his father, he secured a house in Derry for men seeking sobriety and became one of its first residents. The property became the base of a treatment organisation that added inpatient programmes and successive levels of care across New England.

The company's ownership path shifted when Spofford brought in an investment partner. He stepped back from executive management and sold the healthcare group to BayMark Health Services. He retained property interests developed alongside the operating company and made real estate the centre of his next venture, Spofford Enterprises. Its work combines property development and acquisition with selected venture-capital partnerships, while his public business identity remains rooted in building Granite Recovery Centers from one recovery residence.
